  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study reports a quantitative measure of agreement (correlation, predictive ability) between in vitro cytotoxicity data and in vivo rat inhalation toxicity (LC50). It compares animal model results with human clinical outcomes indirectly by using human cell lines to predict animal toxicity, which is then related to human classification.",
  "arm": "toxicology",
  "arm_evidence": "We investigated the conventional submerged 2-D cell culture model as a method for the prediction of acute inhalation toxicity.",

    "respiratory",
    "cross-cutting"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "prediction of acute inhalation toxicity",
  "model_type": "in-vitro-or-in-silico-comparator",
  "model_evidence": "We investigated the conventional submerged 2-D cell culture model as a method for the prediction of acute inhalation toxicity.",
  "species": [
    "rat"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "Median lethal concentration (LC50 ) (rat, inhalation, 4 h) and half maximal inhibitory concentration (IC50 ) (lung or bronchial cell, 24 h) data for 59 substances were obtained from the literature and by experiments.",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "A weak correlation was observed between the IC50 and LC50 of all substances."
